name: Tuned to Your Heart
source:
Local music witch, Cinnamon, has been asked out by Freesia, a very cool ice witch. They've agreed to go eat dinner but Cinnamon has plans to make the date even better! But it has been a long time since she has been on a date! What do you even do on a date!?!?

[From [url=https://kyaniteheart.itch.io/tuned-to-your-heart]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当地的音乐女巫肉桂，收到了酷酷的冰雪女巫小苍兰的约会邀请。她们约好一起吃晚餐，但肉桂还想让这次约会变得更加美好！可是，她已经很久没有约会过了！约会时到底该做些什么啊？！

[摘自[url=https://kyaniteheart.itch.io/tuned-to-your-heart]itch.io[/url]]
